case.name: offer-weekly-report
case.prompt: 帮我写本周周报，下午要交给主管
case.expected_output: Offers a plan briefly, because the noun deliverable and the purpose are unstated; does not dump a generic report.
expectations: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
